source.lineage: same-seed immutable SW0097 seed1 source, mapped through frozen SW0135 native32 foundation
source.required_saved_parity: SW0135 seed1 B4 exact zero-adapter parity at T1024/settle512
source.rgb: registered clean uint8 NHWC [B,128,128,3] source TRAIN cache only

forward.decoder_content_view: gamma.transpose(1,2) [B,1024,8]; likelihood detaches only its content path
forward.actual_q: unchanged SW0145._actual_q from emitted native spike trace
forward.qcc: unchanged SW0136 production _qcc_labels on that same trace
forward.assignment: SW0150 deterministic QCC-derived seeds and 64-step four-neighbor Q diffusion

calibration.sigma2: CPU float64 mean of per-image, per-channel spatial population variance over exactly the first64 registered clean TRAIN IDs

shared_warmup.backbone: source encoder, graph, native core and integration scalars frozen and checked unchanged
shared_warmup.optimizer: Adam LR 1e-3, clip decoder gradient norm to1; save weights, Adam moments/steps and CPU/selected-CUDA RNG
shared_warmup.sharing: both disposable arms load the identical warm decoder state and Adam moments

disposable_feasibility.inputs: same first32 ordered registered source1 TRAIN IDs in both fresh source initializations
disposable_feasibility.clipping: native parameter union norm1 and decoder norm1, clipped separately; project a_d/a_m after each Adam step
disposable_feasibility.purpose: finite loss/gradient/update and source-freeze diagnostics only; no scientific eligibility threshold

artifacts.warm_checkpoint: explicit create-once private work path; contains decoder, optimizer and RNG state plus source/parity/assets/order/code hashes
artifacts.preflight_report: create-once JSON; training_admission remains false pending independent review

limitations: The shared32-update warmup is reported separately and is not the later pilot budget.
Two disposable updates per arm do not demonstrate image segmentation quality or performance.
No claim of fresh native32 70,000-image training or Slot Attention superiority is made.
